relations.title: Capacidad interna después de la salida
Legitimidad en ambos lados de una interfaz
Annex 4 — Canonical Requirements and Test Contract
relations.reading: Readiness depends on evidence remaining valid and actionable within the operating decision window.

relations.title: Measuring Human Intelligence Debt
relations.reading: Knowledge-transfer evidence can include safe novel-exception exercises rather than relying only on document completion.

relations.title: Tiger Team Maturity Model
relations.reading: The industrialization case describes quality-system and audit-readiness work that can illustrate observable maturity practices without claiming a certified maturity level.

relations.title: Field Intelligence in Chicontepec and the Texas–Mérida Corridor
relations.reading: The Texas-to-Mexico case makes regional capability formation tangible through local roles, acceptance criteria and operating records that let the receiving team execute in its own context.

relations.title: JubAp.Net Tiger Team Model
relations.reading: The oilfield deployment illustrates the team-as-system principle: legal, plant, quality and training workstreams must become one usable operating model rather than a collection of completed deliverables.

relations.title: Instituciones de frontera: Cuando emprender es construir un puente entre mundos.
relations.reading: Cross-border legitimacy can support knowledge transfer, but the receiving operation still needs explicit roles, technical readiness and acceptance conditions.
